reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Use DeepCopy when assigning from the runtime config Deployment template's spec by @ulucinar in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6538", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The runtime Deployment created from a DeploymentRuntimeConfig now receives a deep copy of the deployment template's spec rather than a direct reference to it, so the generated spec no longer shares underlying objects with the template.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; after upgrading, verify that runtime Deployments generated from DeploymentRuntimeConfigs behave as expected.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 now uses DeepCopy when assigning from the runtime config Deployment template's spec, so the spec assigned out of a DeploymentRuntimeConfig's deployment template is deep-copied instead of assigned directly.
